purpose: What a person may record on a decision inbox item, and as whom. The decisions are the answers to the question the inbox policy puts: a correction to seek from the publisher, a note on the record, or no action. The roles are the capacities in which a person decides; a decision is recorded under a role, never under a name. The system never decides: a person does, and this table only names the words the record uses.

decisions.meaning: A note is kept beside the record, in the reason given with this decision. Nothing is sent to the publisher.
Nothing follows from this result. The record stands as published and the result stays in the results file as what the rule found.
A correction is sought from the publisher of the record. The reason given with this decision says what is asked and why.
